premises.text: Existing EV cars are slow/expensive/inefficient/limited-range; developing-world two-wheelers are unsafe, hard to drive, limited utility, and pollute
premises.evidence_span: these take forever to get to market. They're incredibly expensive to develop. They're expensive to purchase. They're not actually that efficient. And they have limited range

premises.text: Need a motorcycle-profile vehicle with car safety, weather/off-road versatility, easy driving, affordability, and unprecedented efficiency
premises.evidence_span: something with a small profile and the quick-to-market deployment of a motorcycle. It has to have the safety of a car

premises.text: C1 is a narrow aerodynamic enclosed electric motorcycle with car controls and car-like safety (airbags, belts, reinforced doors, roll cage)
premises.evidence_span: We made an efficient, incredibly romantic motorcycle, but with the safety and the comfort of a car

premises.text: Light platform with off-the-shelf batteries yields ~200 miles/charge on ~1/4 LEAF pack size and ~1/10 car parts for cheap manufacture/maintenance
premises.evidence_span: because it is so light, it gets 200 miles per charge. And that's a one-fourth the battery pack size of a Nissan LEAF

premises.text: Patented dual-gyroscope self-balancing keeps the vehicle upright without rider balance skill
premises.evidence_span: the Lit Motor C1 is the first self-balancing, fully electric motorcycle when we have 15 patents on this technology

premises.text: Deliver at ~$19k in 2014 (scale to ~$10k by 2017) with 200 mi / 100 mph / ~$1 charge via disciplined BOM engineering plan
premises.evidence_span: 2014 for $19,000, and we believe we can get this to scale for only $10,000 in 2017

domains.name: enclosed electric C1 with gyro balance

value.text: Safe, efficient, affordable personal transportation anyone can drive
value.evidence_span: Anyone can drive it. And we're making a safe version

secondary_value.text: Address traffic, parking, environmental destruction as transportation outcomes
secondary_value.evidence_span: transportation is a huge problem. And it goes anywhere from personal annoyances like driving through traffic or finding a parking spot to major issues like environmental destruction and war
